Scope: collector and local roads, potable water, sewerage, storm drainage, irrigation, medium-voltage, street lighting and telecom networks, a sewage pump station and storm drainage ponds for Block J. Contract value 117.4M SAR excluding VAT, 24 months.

Status at a glance

Progress is measured as physical % complete, weighted by budgeted effort (man-days, the same basis as reports 94 and 95). At the 10-Nov-2026 data date the project is 79.6% complete against 88.4% planned, behind by 8.8% (SPI 0.90). Since report 95 it gained 0.92% against 0.78% planned, so the gap narrowed slightly from 8.9%, but the pace is still far below the 2.55% a week needed to finish on the contract date.

The project is still forecast to finish about eight to nine months late. The P6 update of 10-Nov-2026 finishes the project on 06-Oct-2027, 268 days after the contract date of 11-Jan-2027, with −219.5 days of float; that is 45 days earlier than the 03-Nov-2026 update. The weekly report forecasts 16-Sep-2027 (248 days late). With 91.5% of the contract time used, 20.4% of the physical work remains: finishing on time would need 2.55% a week for the 8 weeks left, against 0.92% achieved this week.

This week the Progress sheet records 605 man-days earned against 509 planned: storm drainage 286, procurement 138, roads 90, sewage 53, potable water 26 and 12 across irrigation, medium voltage and street lighting; testing and commissioning earned nothing this week. The P6 update (data date 10-Nov-2026) has 1,921 activities: 1,262 completed, 87 in progress and 572 not started. Its scheduled finish is 06-Oct-2027, 268 days after the contract date.

Data notes

Built from the W07 upload (report 96); the previous week's folder (report 95) was used for this-week changes.

  • The workbook's date fields are now updated (data date 10-Nov-2026, report 96, day 667), but the milestone sheet's contract-week line now reads "0 of 0", so the week number is calculated: 667 days from handover on 12-Jan-2025 gives week 95.
  • The cover now uses the same 65,420 man-day budget as the Progress sheet (88.42% planned, 79.63% earned, SPI 0.90), so last week's mismatch is resolved. Its weekly columns are still wrong: the 509 planned man-days appear against procurement and street lighting instead of the construction networks, and the weekly earned total is 934 against 605 in the Progress sheet.
  • The weekly activities sheet repeats five of report 95's seven lines word for word (100 m of water line, 500 m of capping on road 10, 200 m of storm branch pipe on road 23, manholes and catch basins, lift-station backfill); only the MV cable (321 m) and 315 mm HDPE (100 m) lines changed.
  • The Arabic summary sheet updated the executed quantity of five networks but not their remaining quantity or percentage (storm, for example, shows 23,158 of 24,720 LM executed but still 1,932 remaining and 92.18%). This report recalculates both. The sheet adds 1,021 LM of medium voltage this week, against 321 m of MV cable in the activities sheet and 4,818 m more 33 kV cable in the Major Quantities sheet.
  • The Major Quantities sheet jumped far beyond the reported weekly work (capping 24,003 to 45,013 m³, subgrade 22,243 to 41,713 m³, catch basins 207 to 461, storm GRP 300 mm 5,454 to 8,088 m, street-lighting cable 6,292 to 9,109 m), while its installed potable-water valves fell to zero (gate valves 22, butterfly valves 21 and air valves 7, all now 0). Physical progress rose only 0.92%.
  • Finish dates still disagree: the weekly report gives 16-Sep-2027 and the P6 file 06-Oct-2027. In one week P6 moved every network milestone 34 to 86 days earlier and the project finish 45 days earlier, while physical progress rose only 0.92%; no revised logic or recovery schedule approval is recorded. The P6 project ID changed again, to MOD3-J-2769-BL01-R01-4 (R01-1 last week).
  • The physical forecast in the chart data still reaches 100% in January 2027, against a P6 finish in October 2027. In the chart data the earned effort up to September equals the revised plan month by month.
  • Manpower: the manual plan was cut from 200 to 112 while every actual figure is unchanged from report 95; the cover's trade table totals 120 actual because it leaves out drivers and operators (80), and the next-month forecast changed from 1,148 to 200. The invoice, procurement, risk and issue logs are unchanged from report 95, and the HSE inspection sheet still covers 26-Aug to 01-Sep-2026.
  • Quality statistics show 23 NCRs issued, 2 closed and 21 pending, against 21 issued and 21 closed last week; the closed and pending columns appear to have been swapped.
  • The procurement log still has deliveries above the required quantity (sewer GRP 400 mm SN5000 1,138 of 261 m, potable water 160 mm 214 of 73 m, GRP liner 1,900 mm 43 of 32 m) and unit typos ("m132", "m133"). The summary sheet still gives site handover as 12-Feb-2025 (12-Jan-2025 in the weekly report).
  • Several cover fields show #REF! (EAC, top issues), and the invoice log still has stray values of 21,100,000 and 20,900,000.
  • Photos: nine new photos were uploaded and six are used; the other files in the folder repeat earlier weeks' photos. Only two of the new photos carry a camera date stamp (08 and 09-Nov-2026).
